# Chirag Mirani

> Independent quantitative researcher and app builder. Projects below are public and free to read.

## Apps and readers
- [Shree Hanuman Chalisa (English)](https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/): the Hanuman Chalisa verse by verse in plain English, with the Hindi and the Hindi in English letters. Free iPhone and iPad app: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6819752072
- [Through the Ring PRO](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/): a one-tap arcade game for iPhone and iPad. Pay once, no ads, no tracking.
- [Gita](https://chiragmirani.github.io/gita-quotes/): all 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gita in English.
- [The Vedas reader](https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/) and [The Upanishads reader](https://chiragmirani.github.io/upanishads/).

## Research
- [Live US macro forecast dashboard](https://chiragmirani.github.io/macro-dashboard/): house forecasts and Kalshi consensus for major US releases, with an honest track record.
- [Exposure-Time Normalized Performance (SSRN, 2026)](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6292699)
